status: design record and review record, written BEFORE the preregistration was frozen and before any 0015 fit; the run_record block is filled from the banked artifact after the run and is not a verdict

design.question: Does the encoder-provenance signal survive content the model has never seen? Every verdict so far trains and scores on the same eight content families.
design.protocol_in_one_line: leave-one-family-out: for each family, 0003's fixed recipes (M1, L1, U1) fitted on every pool row of the other seven families, scored once on the sealed set; the eight held-out readings stitched into one mixture accuracy; bar chance + 0.05 on the model's mixture
design.why_fixed_recipes_not_searched: 0014 established that a symmetric search moves both sides; a searched-recipe transfer is a separate preregistration. The question here is about the headline recipe's signal, and M1 at about 700000 rows costs about 20 minutes per fold against several hours for the searched M4.
design.why_the_mixture_and_not_per_family_bars: the record's convention (0011, 0012/0013, 0014): the verdict is the mixture's and the decomposition is published beside it; per-family bars on 32000-row subsets would multiply the clauses and the chances of an incidental fail or pass
design.why_chance_plus_0.05_and_not_a_margin_ov: the question is whether the signal transfers, not whether the model beats a dumb rule under transfer; a logistic that transferred as well as the model would be a finding, not a failure. The same-protocol logistic and majority mixtures are banked as readings, with the margin.
design.expected_outcome_stated_in_advance: genuinely uncertain; the mixture bar is 0.0885 and a mixture near 0.09 is the modal expectation

cost_anchors.note: EXTRAPOLATION from 0014's banked confirmatory fits on this pool (artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_4096.json cost); no new anchor measured

pre_freeze_review.how: three independent refuters (reader against runner; folds, recipes and bar; memory, cost and operations) followed by one synthesis, run on 2026-09-08 before the freeze

findings_adopted.finding: the logistic reproduction clause was anchored on 0003's banked 0.1392 with a 0.005 tolerance, but this exact machinery (the same float64 pool block, fit_one, LogisticRegression(max_iter=400) with lbfgs at its iteration cap, sklearn 1.9.0 / numpy 2.4.6 / 3 threads) produced 0.1352 in 0014: an honest run sat 0.001 from a VOID on a control clause with nothing to do with transfer, the failure class 0012's reader exhibited (CORRECTIONS.md 2026-09-03); raised independently by all three refuters
findings_adopted.fix: the anchor is 0014's same-convention 0.1352 (artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_4096.json logistic_l1_refit.top1) with the 0.005 tolerance unchanged; 0003's 0.1392 is banked beside the reading as a drift reference; the incumbent's 0.2395 anchor is unchanged (0014 reproduced it exactly); the tolerance is compared at 4-decimal precision so 0.005 passes at the boundary in both directions; prereg bar, readings and design text state the choice; the protocol block and its hash are unchanged

findings_adopted.finding: the reader could exit with a traceback instead of VOID on a scores file with a non-integer chunk id or vector entry (never produced by the runner)
findings_adopted.fix: the reader validates chunk ids and every fold vector as integers (vectors in {0,1}) before the recomputation and voids on failure; a mutation case proves VOID-not-crash

findings_adopted.finding: the sealed prereg text over-claimed what the reader checked: the pool's sorted hash was not sealed, the null record's seed/environment/probe were not checked, and scope.sealed_partition used key names the artifact does not bank and omitted train_rows_in_eval
findings_adopted.fix: pool_sorted_sha256 sealed in the reader and the prereg (recomputed from grouped_split; equals 0014's sealed constant for the same pool); the null record goes through the same record checks as every fit; sealed_partition keys match the artifact and carry train_rows_in_eval 0

findings_adopted.finding: the lofo4096 mutation gate left many reader clauses without a mutation (complete=False, per-record params hash, a fold's held-out reading disagreeing with its vector, the headline mixture not the model role's, an absent scores file, the banked environment, the null block hash, the reproduction tolerance boundary)
findings_adopted.fix: ten cases added (25 in the gate; 246 across 18 gates, all detected), including 0.1402 passes / 0.1403 fails at the anchor and 0003's 0.1392 passing as a value 0.004 from it

findings_adopted.finding: on every resume the runner re-gathered the two 7.09 GB pool blocks and the null block for fits already checkpointed (cost only); scope.cost counted eight gathers where the runner performs eleven
findings_adopted.fix: every block is gathered lazily, only when its fit is not checkpointed; cost text says eleven gathers

findings_adopted.finding: stop rule 3 said a failed launch precondition files a NOT RUN marker; the runner refuses to launch (exit 3) and files nothing; a checkpoint deleted after its completion event makes the runner file NOT RUN while the reader, seeing the artifact, reads VOID
findings_adopted.fix: stop rule 3 restated to what the runner and reader do, with an operator rule never to run git stash, git clean or deletions against the checkpoint directory during the run

findings_adopted.finding: scope.cost gave no worst case while no fit has a time cap; it also summed the HGB bin-mapper subsample and the binned copy, which do not coexist in sklearn 1.9.0
findings_adopted.fix: worst case stated: about 70000 s if no fold's early stopping fires (43 s per iteration at 800000 rows from 0014's 1428.4 s / 33 iterations, against the 200-iteration cap); the HGB peak restated

findings_adopted.finding: no guard against a second concurrent launch on the same checkpoint directory; two survivors fitting the same name would leave two completion events and a VOID with no honest repair
findings_adopted.fix: not changed in code: the 12.0 GB MemAvailable launch precondition refuses a second launch whenever the first holds a pool or fold block, and the poll script relaunches only when no runner process is alive; recorded here as the operator's exposure

pre_freeze_review.synthesis_verdict: fix_then_freeze: one blocking finding, fixed before the freeze; every non-blocking finding adopted except where noted
pre_freeze_review.mixture_agreement_how_established: the smoke run cannot exercise the reader's mixture clauses (its fold and reproduction records void first, and the recomputation is skipped once a fit clause has voided). Agreement was established two ways: an independent re-stitch of the smoke's per-example vectors by chunk-id family equals the runner's banked mixtures, per-family readings and stitched vectors bit for bit for all three roles; and a refuter's sandbox copy of the smoke with only the smoke-sized fields patched to the sealed values read zero validity failures and TRANSFER_FAILS at 0.0818, with Python round(int/int, 4) shown equal to round(float(np.int8.mean()), 4) for every (count, n) pair over the eleven denominators involved.

operator_procedure.repeated_launches_of_one_fit: a fit killed within 30 s of its last heartbeat is never stamped infeasible_memory; repeated launches of the same fit with no new checkpoint are the operator's signal to stop and file the VOID by hand, with the launches ledger as evidence
operator_procedure.checkpoint_directory: never run git stash, git clean or any deletion against artifacts/pivot/lofo_4096_ckpt during the run: a checkpoint lost after its completion event is a terminal VOID for that fit
operator_procedure.concurrent_launch: never launch a second runner while one is alive; the poll script checks pgrep before relaunching and the 12.0 GB launch precondition refuses a launch while a block is held
